Job description:
We are building a serious path in the field of developing AI products, intelligent automations, AI Agents, RAG, SaaS, and specialized AI training at Nakas, and we are looking for a technical, creative, responsible, and growth-oriented teammate. This position is not just a simple operational collaboration. We are looking for someone who can actively participate in the design, development, implementation, and growth of AI-based products alongside the team, in the role of a Technical Partner. 

Job Title: Python / AI Developer
Collaboration Type: In-person / Hybrid, negotiable percentage + project participation, long-term and growth-oriented collaboration.
Areas of Collaboration: Development of AI products, design and implementation of AI Tools, Automation, and SaaS; Design and development of AI Agents, RAG, and AI Workflows; Implementation of real-world projects with Python; Working on open-source models and intelligent systems; Participation in creating educational content and specialized AI courses; Collaboration in ideation, design, and development of startup products; Assistance in building the technical infrastructure for training and executing AI projects.

Expected Qualifications: Full mastery of Python; Understanding of Machine Learning, Deep Learning, and LLMs; Experience working with frameworks like PyTorch, Hugging Face, and Transformers; Ability to design and develop AI Agents, RAG, and AI Workflows; Familiarity with open-source models and local model execution; Ability to design and develop products, not just connect APIs; Understanding of model structures, data processing, Embedding, Vector Databases, and AI Pipelines; Ability to solve problems, research, test, document, and develop independently; Teamwork spirit, responsibility, and a desire to learn, grow, and teach.

Points Considered: Experience in developing or Fine-tuning AI models; Experience working with open-source models like Llama, Qwen, Mistral, Gemma, and similar models; Experience designing and developing multi-agent systems; Experience deploying models on GPU, dedicated servers, or local infrastructure; Familiarity with MLOps, Docker, Linux, and development environment management; Experience with Vector Databases and RAG architectures; Experience teaching, creating specialized content, or training in the field of AI.

Working with AI model APIs as a supplementary asset, not the main skill: What is the difference? We are not looking for someone who only executes specific tasks. Our goal is to collaborate with an individual who can play a real role in the technical and product growth of the projects.

In this role, you can work on real, revenue-generating, and scalable projects, from designing and developing AI tools to building educational products, enterprise automations, custom Agents, and AI-based SaaS services.

Benefits of Collaboration: Share of project revenue, participation in product and training profits, working on real and revenue-generating projects, opportunity for startup growth, visibility in brands, products, and educational outputs, opportunity to participate in technical and product decisions.

Key Point: This position is not suitable for individuals who only work with ready-made model APIs. We are looking for someone with a deeper understanding of AI architecture, intelligent system design, open-source models, RAG, Agents, Workflows, and product development, who can play a serious and independent role from the design stage through implementation and deployment.

How to Apply: To apply for collaboration review, please send your resume, portfolio, GitHub, completed projects, or a description of your related experiences.

Company description:
About Us | Rastinax Company Rastinax Company began its official activities in 1397 by developing advanced desktop and mobile software, and through the expansion of its services in website design, SEO, and digital marketing, it has become one of the leading companies in digital transformation. At Rastinax, we believe that the future of every business depends on intelligent presence in the online world. Our mission is to accompany and empower brands to enter the digital space and achieve real and sustainable growth. A combination of technical expertise, market knowledge, creativity, and a results-oriented view has made Rastinax the first choice for many brands in the digitalization journey. Our vision is to become one of the most influential digital-oriented companies in Iran and the region, focusing on innovation, performance, and creating real value for businesses. We are ready to help you bring your business to a new level of digital success alongside you.
